name: plate_spheres_8
comment: exp-002 base case: 10x10x4 mm plate, simple cubic packing of 8 spheres R=1.2 mm, pitch 2.5 mm in x, 5 mm in y, 4 mm in z (the 4x2x1 layout is the only arrangement of 8 spheres with R=1.2 where every sphere lies fully inside the 4 mm plate and none intersect: 2R=2.4 < 2.5). The subtraction is the fluid domain (closed pores, not open at the domain faces).
